# Recursive Enum type-token factories

Independently authored Java8 classes retain a complete Enum<Self> method bound
inside an owner with a separately scoped formal of the same name. A Class<E>
argument binds the invariant returned carrier. The frozen observer compares
opaque provider actions, token identity, exact failures, casts and ignored calls,
and also checks the original JDK EnumSet.noneOf call using valid and invalid
tokens. Source and SDK modes independently compare all original metadata and
compiled definitions. Private sample bytes and behavior are excluded.
